source: TPC-H Standard Specification Revision 3.0.1: Clause 1.4.1 (columns and primary keys), Clause 1.4.2.3 (foreign keys), Clause 4.2.2.9 (phone numbers), Clause 4.2.3 (database population)
rule: Each wide table joins TPC-H tables along foreign keys of Clause 1.4.2.3, and the foreign-key column and the referenced primary-key column are merged into one column (named after the referencing side). Sigma* is the union of the truths of the joined tables (as in e2/tpch_truth.json) and the FDs induced by the joins: the merged key column determines every column of the referenced table. A column that Clause 4.2.3 generates at random determines nothing, even when it is unique on the instance. O_SHIPPRIORITY is the constant 0 (Clause 4.2.3) and is dropped.

instance.command: dbgen -s 0.1 (default seed); gen_tpch.py joins the tables
instance.construction: ORDERS JOIN CUSTOMER ON O_CUSTKEY = C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION ON C_NATIONKEY = N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION ON N_REGIONKEY = R_REGIONKEY; C_CUSTKEY, N_NATIONKEY and R_REGIONKEY are merged into O_CUSTKEY, C_NATIONKEY and N_REGIONKEY

truth.justification: O_ORDERKEY is the primary key of ORDERS. O_ORDERSTATUS and O_TOTALPRICE are computed from the order's lineitems (Clause 4.2.3), which are not in this table, so they are functions of the order and of nothing else here.
C_CUSTKEY is the primary key of CUSTOMER, and O_CUSTKEY references it, so every row carries the columns of the one customer with that key.
C_NAME is 'Customer#' followed by C_CUSTKEY with at least 9 digits and leading zeros, an injective function of the key.
C_PHONE is generated by Clause 4.2.2.9, whose country code is C_NATIONKEY + 10, so the phone number determines the nation.
N_NATIONKEY is the primary key of NATION, and C_NATIONKEY references it.
N_NAME is taken from a fixed series of 25 (N_NATIONKEY, N_NAME, N_REGIONKEY) triples with distinct names.
R_REGIONKEY is the primary key of REGION, and N_REGIONKEY references it.
R_NAME is taken from a fixed series of five (R_REGIONKEY, R_NAME) pairs with distinct names.

random_columns: O_ORDERDATE, O_ORDERPRIORITY, O_CLERK, O_COMMENT, C_ADDRESS, C_ACCTBAL, C_MKTSEGMENT, C_COMMENT, N_COMMENT and R_COMMENT are random values or text strings (Clause 4.2.3). O_CUSTKEY is a random customer key not divisible by 3.
gold_design_note: The original TPC-H tables. CUSTOMER is not in 3NF under Sigma*: C_PHONE -> C_NATIONKEY has a non-key left-hand side and a non-prime right-hand side.

mined.algorithm: fdmine.py: exact discovery of all minimal FDs in the style of HyFD (no HyFD binary was available); the complete set of minimal FDs is unique, so it equals HyFD's output
